claim: Proposal proposal-receipt.md section 3 row 1.6, server half (founder /goal 2026-11-07 delegated every fork): DocumentExtractorService.detectMediaType decodes the first 12 bytes of the paper and, when bytes 4-7 are 'ftyp' with a HEIF brand (heic heix hevc hevx heim heis hevm hevs mif1 msf1) or an AVIF brand (avif avis) at 8-11, extract() returns an unread ParsedDocument (docType unknown, every field null, one warning naming the format and asking for a JPEG or a re-take) before the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY guard and without calling the model client. The check runs before the declared mime, so HEIC bytes labelled image/jpeg are refused too. The final fallback for unrecognised bytes is no longer 'image/jpeg' but unread with the reason UNREADABLE_FILE_FORMAT. The spec builds real ftyp header bytes and asserts the mocked model client is called 0 times.
verify: grep -qF 'head.toString("latin1", 4, 8) !== "ftyp"' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-extractor.service.ts && grep -qF 'if (iso) return { unreadable: unreadablePhotoFormat(iso) };' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-extractor.service.ts && grep -qF 'return { unreadable: UNREADABLE_FILE_FORMAT };' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-extractor.service.ts && grep -qF 'if ("unreadable" in format) return unreadDocument(format.unreadable);' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-extractor.service.ts && grep -qF 'stores a HEIC photo unread with its reason and never calls the model' apps/api-gateway/src/procurement/documents/document-extractor.spec.ts
